summary: Probably John's 4th-great-grand-uncle; husband of Huldah Ives.
bio: Inferred son of Samuel and Martha: the widow Hulda (Ives) Pringle's children were named Orange, Ransom and Keturah - Lamoreaux family names - making her husband very probably a Samuel Jr. No record names him directly.
